notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections, acts May 12, 1933, ch. 30, §§ 1, 2, 48 Stat. 55, 56; Feb. 15, 1934, ch. 13, § 1, 48 Stat. 351, were enacted as temporary legislation during the economic emergency in 1933.
